level.verb: page the rulebook to back a question
level.scene: JUDGE REDESIGN (was a crew-card roster that duplicated do_7_10_a). A drawn LT lane under a shutdown job at morning: a DTR on a plinth, a feeder pillar, a new house whose balcony reaches toward the service line, the crew van with a kit crate and a helmet hook, and today's helper (one figure, his ID card on a lanyard). The trainee holds a phone (work orders arrive from the supervisor as phone texts, a real thing a worker reads) and the pocket CEA rulebook, a 5-page booklet in fixed order: 'রেগুলেশন 3 · উপযুক্ত ব্যক্তি', 'রেগুলেশন 15 · বিপজ্জনক নোটিশ', 'রেগুলেশন 18 · আর্থিং', 'রেগুলেশন 32 · ক্লিয়ারেন্স', 'নিজের অধিকার · টুলস, PPE, নিরাপদ পরিবেশ'. The supervisor is heard only through the phone (no new drawn character).
flow: Guide first (no skip): 'আজ সুপারভাইজার ফোনে কাজের নির্দেশ দেবেন। নিয়মে না মিললে রুলবুক দেখিয়ে প্রশ্ন করুন।'

An order slides in as phone text (voice-locked until read). Its words are the same for the lawful and unlawful version; only the scene decides: 'ছোটন আজ পোলে উঠবে।' (helper's ID card back: প্রশিক্ষণ সম্পূর্ণ + অনুমোদন সই-সিল, or one of them missing) · 'পিলারটা চালু করে দাও।' (plate fixed on the door, or bare door / plate on the ground) · 'ট্রান্সফরমার চালুর জন্য রেডি করো।' (body and neutral earth leads both connected, or one cut/hanging) · 'বারান্দার পাশের সার্ভিস লাইনটা চালু রাখো।' (line clear above, or resting on the new balcony) · 'স্টোরের কিট নিয়েই কাজ শুরু করো।' (helmet in the crate, or crate and hook empty).
Look (free): tap any scene object for a close-up (ID card back, pillar door, earth leads, balcony, kit crate). Close-ups show real markings only.

Decide: tap 'ঠিক আছে' (the crew carries out the order) or hold 'সুপারভাইজারকে ফোন' 1.2 s. On a call the supervisor asks 'কোন নিয়মে?'; the rulebook opens; the player swipes its pages and drags the open page onto the phone (shows it).

Right page on an unlawful order → supervisor: 'ঠিক, আগে ওটা ঠিক করো।' → right sound, ◆ on the table → reason deck 'কেন প্রশ্ন করলেন?' → এগিয়ে যান → the lawful fix plays (a fit man climbs, the plate is fixed, the lead is joined, the line stays off, a helmet comes).

Wrong page → slip: 'এতে তো এ কথা নেই' + MistakeCard naming the right page; page again. Call on a lawful order → slip (needless stop): 'সব তো ঠিক আছে, দেখেছ?'. 'ঠিক আছে' on an unlawful order → slip: the act plays, MistakeCard + পাঠে দেখুন.
6 orders per play (5 types, one may repeat in its other version), 2–4 unlawful; the first right 'ঠিক আছে' of a play also asks 'কেন মেনে নিলেন?'.

Pressure moment (dealt order, lawful or unlawful version alike): the first touch on 'ঠিক আছে' or the phone button is held (holdForCoworker). Beat 1: caption + his voice, myth 1 word for word. Beat 2: chip, guide 'ওঁকে কী বলবেন?', refuse/listen deck. Then the order still waits for the player's own decision.
Pass panel ('আজ যা ধরলেন': each question asked and its page) or strike-out at 3 slips.
level.dealtVariety: Which 6 orders and which version of each; helper's card state; which side the plate/earth leads are drawn; balcony state; crate contents; coworker's order and side; reason options from libraries (≥ 2 right, ≥ 5 wrong, within 1.3×).
slips: 'ঠিক আছে' on an unlawful order (unfit helper climbs under the shutdown; pillar charged with no plate; DTR readied with an earth lead open; line kept on against the balcony; work started without a helmet)
Calling on a lawful order (needless stop)
level.coworkerPushBn: 'এসব আইনকানুন তো শুধু কাগজের জন্য, মাঠে কেউ মানে না।' — myth 1 word for word (the board rival's clip reused). Comes on a dealt order at the first touch of either decision control; that control waits for him. Refuse: 'তদন্তে CEA নিয়মই স্ট্যান্ডার্ড — লঙ্ঘনে জরিমানা থেকে জেল' / 'অসুরক্ষিত মনে হলে প্রশ্ন করার অধিকার আমার আছে'. Listen: 'ঠিক, যা বলছে করে ফেলি' / 'কাগজে কী আসে যায়, কাজ সারি'.
level.gestureHints: Order read, waiting: sweep over every tappable scene object and both decision controls equally (presses none; the phone button carries its own label 'চেপে ধরুন'). Close-up open: tap its close control. Rulebook open: swipe hint left then right on the booklet (both directions), then a drag hint from the booklet toward the phone (the only drop target, so it shows how, not which page). Supervisor reply / order arrival: voice-locked, no hint. Decks: built-in sweep; zoomed card: tap এগিয়ে যান. Off during intro, praise window, coworker beat 1, cards, results. Kit limits as usual.
lessonPoints: এই নিয়মগুলো জানা আপনাকে শুধু সুরক্ষিতই রাখে না, বরং কোনো অনিরাপদ কাজের নির্দেশ দিলে আপনি আইনের ভিত্তিতে প্রশ্ন করার অধিকারও রাখেন।
৪. প্রশ্ন করতে শিখুন: যদি কোনো কাজকে আপনার কাছে CEA নিয়ম অনুযায়ী অসুরক্ষিত বলে মনে হয়, তবে আপনার সুপারভাইজারের সাথে কথা বলুন। আপনার প্রশ্ন করার অধিকার আছে।
২. নিজের অধিকার জানুন: আইন অনুযায়ী, আপনার কোম্পানি আপনাকে সঠিক টুলস, PPE এবং নিরাপদ কাজের পরিবেশ দিতে বাধ্য।
৩. অজ্ঞতা কোনো অজুহাত নয়: 'আমি আইনটি জানতাম না'—এটি কোনো দুর্ঘটনার পর অজুহাত হিসেবে গৃহীত হয় না।
level.giveawayRisks: The order text is identical on lawful and unlawful versions, so only looking decides. 2–4 of 6 unlawful, so 'always call' and 'always obey' both strike out. The rulebook pages are in fixed order and all equal; showing the wrong page costs a slip, so paging through every page is not free. The supervisor never names the page before it is shown. Nothing in the scene is ringed. Distinct verb: no crew staffing (do_7_10_a owns that), no breach tagging in a scene (do_7_1_a); the act is questioning an order with the rule as backing.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Module deadly list: unsigned field copy or verbal permit; torn/unrated 11 kV gloves (and no gloves on a hook); cut harness webbing; live hook removal; uncertified person on energised live-line work; charging the line with a man up (F12); a public rod/bamboo reaching the line (7.3b); letting the coworker coil a wire not proven dead (7.7a S2); entering a fallen wire's zone. Everything else is a slip. Confirm each 'needsOwner' row.
ownerDecisions.question: Module 7 'deadly' list (level ends at once): field PTW copy not signed, or a spoken 'line off' with no paper; torn or wrong-rated gloves on an 11 kV job; cut harness strap; pulling a theft hook off a live line; untrained man on live-line work; asking to charge the line while a man is still up; a passer-by's rod touching the line because you did not warn; letting a coworker coil a fallen wire not proven dead; walking into a fallen wire's zone. Everything else is a small mistake (slip). Confirm?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Approved as written: the module deadly list; everything else = slip; every needsOwner row on that list is confirmed.
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.recommended: (a) Every row already matches an earlier ruling; the glove change is A5.
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Confirm the list, with one change: no gloves on a hook is deadly only while the line is not yet proven dead and earthed. After tester 0 V and earth, missing gloves (or any PPE) = slip. Listening to the coworker takes the class of the act he pushes.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M1 step 17 + B7 (no PTW = deadly). B6 (bad glove = deadly). M1 steps 11-12 (harness). B8/X1 (touching live = deadly). M5-1 (charging with anyone on the line = deadly). M5-5 (bystander contact = deadly). M5-4 (inside 10 m = deadly). A5/X4 (no PPE after a proven isolation = slip). B1 (listening = class of the act).

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Rule: letting another person touch a conductor you could have stopped = deadly (7.3b, 7.7a S2). Accept, or make both heavy slips?

ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: DEADLY: letting another person touch a conductor you could have stopped (7.3b, 7.7a S2). Matches M6-1 (signing a broken earth because coworker B said so = deadly).
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Deadly, but only after a clear, timed chance to warn. A late but successful stop = slip.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M5-5: a bystander's contact = deadly for the player; late but successful stop = slip.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Rule: past acts judged at an inquiry desk are always slips (do_7_4_b), while the same act done in the field carries its own class (F12). Accept?
